acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-sieve-native -- environment; all tests pass
description:
Add 'environment' extension support to stoa-sieve-native.

File: crates/sieve-native/src/lib.rs

Changes:
1. Add 'environment' to KNOWN extensions list (line 66):
   const KNOWN: &[&str] = &["fileinto", "reject", "variables", "regex", "environment"];

2. Add Environment variant to the compile/eval form handling.
   The environment test has this grammar (RFC 5183 §4):
     ENVIRONMENT-TEST = 'environment' [MATCH-TYPE] [COMPARATOR]
                        <item: string-list> <key-list: string-list>
   item is the environment name; key-list is the values to match against.
   Uses the same match-type logic as header/envelope tests (is, contains, matches, regex).

3. Add SieveEnv to the evaluate() call signature:
   pub fn evaluate(script: &[Form], message: &[u8], env: &SieveEnv) -> SieveOutcome
   where SieveEnv is a new struct:
   pub struct SieveEnv {
       pub values: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,
   }
   impl SieveEnv {
       pub fn new() -> Self
       pub fn set(&mut self, key: impl Into<String>, value: impl Into<String>)
       pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> &str  // returns "" if absent (RFC 5183 §4)
   }

4. Update all existing evaluate() call sites in tests and stoa-smtp
   to pass SieveEnv::new() (empty env, backward compatible).

Defensive rules:
- Unknown environment names return empty string, never error (RFC 5183 §4)
- environment test without require ["environment"] must fail at compile
- Match types (is/contains/matches) work identically to header test

Tests (add to lib.rs #[cfg(test)]):
- environment_unknown_name_returns_empty: env has no 'x', test env "x" "" → true
- environment_known_name_matches: env has vnd.stoa.dkim-result=pass, test "pass" → true
- environment_known_name_no_match: env has dkim-result=fail, test "pass" → false
- environment_list_match: test against ["pass", "none"] → true when value in list
- environment_requires_extension: script without require ["environment"] → compile error
- environment_contains_match: :contains comparator works
title: sieve-native: implement environment test (RFC 5183)
